_readme: Product registry for the Monday pin batch builder. Pin ONLY products with "live": true and a real Etsy listing URL. To add a product once it is live on Etsy: set live to true, paste its listing URL into link, and check its board exists on Pinterest (exact name). Screens for each product live in tools/screens/<key>/. Facts and numbers on pins must come from those screens or the notes here. Links use the shop's Share & Save address (https://lifefreedomstore.etsy.com/listing/<id>, from 10 Nov 2026) so pin sales earn the Share & Save fee refund.

networth.name: Net Worth Tracker & Financial Planner
networth.kw: net worth tracker spreadsheet, financial planner, 10 year forecast, personal finance, google sheets, excel
networth.notes: v1.1 (13 Nov 2026), same listing. Say what's new and true: 10-year forecast with what's driving it (compounding, saving, property, debt paid off); Future Plans for dated life changes (maternity leave pay drop, nursery/childcare, more into a pension), month by month and over 10 years; liquid net worth and the Life Freedom Formula (months your liquid money covers your costs); UK take-home pay and £100k check (GBP file only, say 'UK version'); Example + Blank files, £ and $. Never call it a budget planner or FIRE calculator. Numbers on pins only from tools/screens/networth/. Pins end with: 'Planning tool, not financial advice.'

endoflife.name: UK End of Life Planner – If I Die Binder
endoflife.kw: end of life planner, if i die binder uk, death binder, estate planning uk, will template uk
endoflife.notes: UK only (England & Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland). Fillable A4 PDF + printable PDF + linked tracker + UK will templates with signing guidance. Tone: calm and practical, never fear-based; no legal-advice claims (say 'organiser' and 'will template', never 'legally binding will'). Pins end with: 'An organiser, not legal advice.'

bookkeeping.name: UK Bookkeeping & Self Assessment Tracker
bookkeeping.kw: small business bookkeeping, self assessment uk, bookkeeping spreadsheet uk, sole trader, expense tracker
bookkeeping.notes: Never say HMRC approved, HMRC recognised, MTD compliant, MTD software or official. Matt (9 Nov 2026) wants bold, question-led advertising for this product: at least half its pins use the 'bold' template with hooks from tools/samples_bookkeeping_bold.py (PINS and HOOKS lists), plus new hooks in the same voice (e.g. 'Are you ready for Self Assessment?', 'Struggling with Self Assessment as a small business owner?'). Hooks may be questions; no fear tactics, no penalty threats, no promised outcomes. MTD hooks must say who it applies to (income over £30,000 from April 2027). Dec–Jan: lean on the 31 January Self Assessment deadline. Pins end with: 'Record-keeping tool, not tax advice.'

invoices-plumber.notes: Each trade listing is tailored: say what's specific to this trade (its price list, registrations, CIS or the room calculator).
